title: The Spoon Mod
description: Spoons for one spoons for all!
body:
Welcome to the Spoon mod!

Have you ever sat and thought to yourself "Hm, Minecraft should add spoons." well this mod is for you!

This mod adds spoons to the game.
Yeah it is simple, basic, even dumb, but it just adds that one little thing missing to minecraft.

Spoons can be used as small cheap shovels.

But lets not forget about the legindary Wooden spoon... the #1 weapon for all mothers around the world, this particular spoon can be used as a weapon and a tool making it a great multitool.

Have fun!
